scope: Independent arithmetic and accounting-boundary check of four-year conditional cash forecast. Not validation of future forecasts, cash-credit collectibility or equity value.
economic_limits: Foundry breakeven, margin evolution, capital taper and cash-credit timing are analytical forecasts, not empirical estimates or independently proven outcomes.
Annual cash deficits do not determine required new external funding without opening liquidity, maturities, retained minimum cash and intra-year timing.
Pre-incentive cash excludes unestimated future incentives; the separate finite receivable collection does not imply a recurring subsidy.
The result cannot be compared directly with a Gordon cash amount to infer stock upside or downside; no endpoint valuation is computed.
Ordinary interest excludes capitalized interest contained in cash PPE; total D&A includes corporate amortization once; recurring SBC remains charged once.
